(Quest)]] }} '''Ragunna''' is the largest known city-state in [[Rinascita]], ruled by the [[Order of the Deep]] and centred on its thriving [[Ragunna City|port city]]. It is protected by the [[Sentinel]] [[Imperator]] and the local Ragunessi maintain the strongest connection to Them in all of Rinascita. [[Common Echoes]] are a normal sight in Ragunna, believed to be gifts from the Sentinel carrying Their divine will. Ragunna can be reached during {{Quest|Through the Sea Thou Break}}. ==Regions== {| class="article-table alternating-colors-table tdc1" style="width: 100%;" ! style="width: 200px;" |Name !Description |- id="Ragunna City" |[[File:Ragunna City.png|180px]]
[[Ragunna City]] |Ragunna City, the administrative center of the Ragunna city-state in Rinascita, is a thriving port city by the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways. The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel carrying Their divine will. |- id="Averardo Vault" |[[File:Averardo Vault.png|180px]]
[[Averardo Vault]] |Built by the Montelli family, Averardo Vault stands like a heavily guarded fortress on the outskirts of the city. Within its walls lies the family's vast collection of treasures, including precious metals, artworks, and rare Echoes. The vault also provides public services such as secure storage for valuables, appraisals, and acquisition of rare collections. |- id="Penitent's End" |[[File:Penitent's End.png|180px]]
[[Penitent's End]] |This forsaken island, shrouded in dense sea mist, is dominated by steep cliffs with giant ringed structures. Ships caught in the currents often end up stranded on the island's treacherous shores. For those lucky enough to survive the wreck, even greater horrors await... |- id="Hallowed Reach" |[[File:Hallowed Reach.png|180px]]
[[Hallowed Reach]] | |- id="Whisperwind Haven" |[[File:Whisperwind Haven.png|180px]]
[[Whisperwind Haven]] |Whisperwind Haven stretches across a vast plain outside Ragunna, adorned with uniquely shaped windmills and babbling streams.
When the wind sweeps through, the windmills turn in graceful unison, rippling the streams below. Together, the wind and water merge harmoniously, flowing into the mystical sea of clouds. |- id="Nimbus Sanctum" |[[File:Nimbus Sanctum.png|180px]]
[[Nimbus Sanctum]] |The sea of clouds lingering in this place is formed by concentrated Remnant Energy. Local legends of Ragunna speak of a serene, mirror-like area at the heart of Nimbus Sanctum, said to purify the darkest of thoughts and transform them into part of the clouds. At times, a haunting melody can be heard echoing from the depths of the sanctum. |- id="Fagaceae Peninsula" |[[File:Fagaceae Peninsula.png|180px]]
[[Fagaceae Peninsula]] |This peninsula thick with oak trees was once where Rinascita's rulers gathered for secret councils. The Oracles carved into the stone and trees have withstood the passage of time, though their messages are now nearly impossible to distinguish. |- id="Thessaleo Fells" |[[File:Thessaleo Fells.png|180px]]
[[Thessaleo Fells]] |The rugged mountains of Thessaleo Fells always seem shrouded in the darkness of night, their gloom as deep as the abyssal sea. Once the domain of the Fisalia family, the oldest lineage in Ragunna, this desolate place remains one few outsiders dare to tread. |- id="Vault Underground" |[[File:Vault Underground.png|180px]]
[[Vault Underground]] |Tucked beneath the Sea of Clouds lies a vast depository zone of the Averardo Vault.
Each item moved to the Vault will be meticulously transported to its designated storage location, where it will be safeguarded with the utmost care and precision. |- id="Riccioli Islands" |[[File:Riccioli Islands.jpg|180px]]
[[Riccioli Islands]] |A group of islands northwest of Ragunna, rich in various marine resources. Falling out of the governance of the Order of the Deep, these islands have preserved the customs from Rinascita's Age of a Thousand Islands era, setting them apart from the rest of Ragunna in lifestyle. However, rumor has it a great mystery lies hidden within this secluded paradise... |- id="Avinoleum" |[[File:Avinoleum.png|180px]]
[[Avinoleum]] |Once a theological seminary of Rinascita, it now rests in the boundless expanse of clouds.
It once recorded Rinascita's glory and grandeur, along with countless unspeakable secrets. |- id="Beohr Waters" |[[File:Beohr Waters.png|180px]]
[[Beohr Waters]] |Once a sacred land, only a faint shadow of Avinoleum's glory remains.
Those destined to fall still live, while those meant to survive lie buried, transformed into divine oracles no one hears.
Their lips remain sealed, and Their ears are bound by words They never spoke. |- id="Fabricatorium of the Deep" |[[File:Fabricatorium of the Deep.png|180px]]
[[Fabricatorium of the Deep]] |The Fabricatorium of the Deep is a facility hidden in the unfathomed depths of the sea, where Common Echoes are manufactured, recycled, and studied. At its heart stands the Lumen Tower, composed of experimental zones that are arranged in a circular fashion and interconnected by pathways; everything here serves to maintain the smooth running of the facility. |} ==Quests== {{Quest by Category List|Ragunna Quests}} ==Government== ===The Order of the Deep=== {{Main|Order of the Deep}} The Order of the Deep handle various affairs, from city management, diplomacy and overseeing all Common Echoes. They have declared themselves Imperator's earthly emissaries, ensuring the people remain faithful to Their ([[Imperator]]'s) divine will. The Order of the Deep's leader is known as the Primus, and the order's current Primus, Fenrico, has declared himself to be Imperator's "Enlightened One". Serving beneath the Primus, Priests oversee the rites and sacred duties of the Order, while the Acolytes dedicate their lives to the study of the Codex and spreading Imperator's teachings throughout Ragunna. The armed Common Echoes that only respond to the Order are called the La Guardia. In Ragunna, the Order controls all Terminals for Echo use. They store Echoes in their Data Bank and only grant access after thorough screening, thus only a select few Resonators are permitted to carry a [[Pangu Terminal]] of their own, deemed Reserved Terminals in Ragunna. For that reason, most Ragunnesi rely on the Genesis Nexus and Common Echoes, and do not know much of other Echoes, referred to as Reserved Echoes. Their seat of power is the [[Cathedral of Mercury]]. ===Montelli Family=== {{Main|Montelli Family}} Aside from the Order, the families of Ragunna influence the power dynamics of the city, primarily the [[Montelli Family|Montelli]] and [[Fisalia Family|Fisalia]] families. Renowned for their pioneering spirit, the Montelli family played an instrumental role in charting trade routes that not only connect Ragunna, but also greater Rinascita to the wider world. As the city opened its doors, the Montellis rose to prominence, amassing great wealth and influence. The Montelli family also took the lead in introducing and developing Reserved Terminals across Ragunna. While the Order of the Deep dismissed these Terminals as an inferior mockery of the Genesis Nexus and Common Echoes, the Montellis secured the Order's approval to continue their development in secrecy, offering guarantees of safety and hefty tax payment in exchange. Unlike the more traditional families, the Montelli family values emotional bonds and shared ideals above bloodlines and social standing. They advocate for the distribution of opportunities and wealth, believing that riches are worth more when they circulate. Though are often ridiculed by traditional families as "nouveau riche." They are most prevalent in two locations within the Ragunna City: the [[Montelli Quarter]] that serves as their base of operations, and the [[Averardo Vault]], the leading bank in all of Rinascita. the Montelli family played a key role in hosting the most recent Carnevale. This endeavor, however, earned them the disdain of the Order of the Deep and, by extension, the Fisalias. [[Francesco Montelli]] is the current head of the Montelli Family. ===Fisalia Family=== {{Main|Fisalia Family}} The Fisalias are also one of the most powerful, and certainly the oldest and most traditional, families in Ragunna, renowned for their expertise in medicine and poison, their craft of extracting toxins from aquatic plants is a legacy passed down in their family. [[Rosemary's Apothecary]] is known for its artful blending of medicine and poison and the owner, [[Rosemary]], is a skilled Fisalia pharmacist, yet whispers surrounding the Fisalia family have kept many Ragunnesi wary, leaving her shop paricularly lack of customers. According to rumors, the ancestors of the Fisalia Family were the first to arrive in the islands of Rinascita and the first to establish order and once ignited a war, but were defeated and driven out of the city. They are said to predate the Order of the Deep thus their close ties with the religious order. They are well-known for their devotion to the [[Sentinel]] Imperator and are often perceived as mystic nobles delighting in the schemes of power. A faction within the Fisalia family believes that the Montelli family's embrace of openness and the privatization of Echoes is a direct affront to Imperator's teachings, threatening to lead Ragunna into an abyss of heresy. They have directly opposed the Montellis through various means. Aside from [[Porto-Veno Castle]], the current Fisalia Residencies in Ragunna are near the Cathedral of Mercury. As the subject of many notorious rumors, their name is unwelcomed by citizens, who call them the "Poison of Ragunna". Cantarella is the thirty-sixth matriarch of the Fisalia family, and the former Blessed Maiden of Imperator. ==Resonators== ===Playable=== {{Resonators by Category Table|Playable Resonators&Ragunna}} ===Upcoming=== {{Resonators by Category Table|Upcoming Resonators&Ragunna}} ==Gallery== Ragunna Terminal.png|Ragunna Terminal Ragunna Gondola.png|Echo Gondola Ragunna Octopus Echo.png|Bell-striking Octopus Echo Ragunna Bear Echo.png|Echo that can be found in Ragunna ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Ragunna |zhs = 拉古那 |zht = 拉古那 |ja = ラグーナ |ko = 라군나 |es = Raguna |fr = Ragunna |de = Ragunna |th = |pt = }} ==Change History== {{Change History|introduced=1.4}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==Navigation== {{Location Navbox|Rinascita}} [[zh:拉古那]]
